```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(float(value), 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    tot_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    tot_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    tot_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tot_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", tot_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if tot_ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", tot_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY) where available")
    if tot_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (tot_tw - tot_lw) / tot_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if tot_ly > 0:
        m = df["Revenue_LY"].notna()
        a, b = df.loc[m, "Revenue_TW"].sum(), df.loc[m, "Revenue_LY"].sum()
        if b > 0:
            add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (a - b) / b * 100,
                "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 over rows with LY")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (df["Units_TW"].sum() - u_lw) / u_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")

    top = df.sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for the entity")
        if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"]):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", round(float(r["Share_Pct"]), 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if tot_tw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", round(top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tot_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    top1 = df.loc[df["Rank"].idxmin()] if df["Rank"].notna().any() else None
    if top1 is not None:
        add(top1["Entity"], "rank", "TW", top1["Rank"], "Rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["delta"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    if len(d):
        for _, r in d.sort_values("delta", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["delta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        for _, r in d.sort_values("delta").head(3).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["delta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    mat = df[(df["WoW_Pct"].notna()) & (df["Revenue_TW"] >= df["Revenue_TW"].quantile(0.75))]
    if len(mat):
        r = mat.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(float(r["WoW_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100, top-quartile revenue only")
        r = mat.sort_values("WoW_Pct").iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(float(r["WoW_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100, top-quartile revenue only")

    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    if len(y):
        y["ydelta"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
        r = y.sort_values("ydelta", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["ydelta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        r = y.sort_values("ydelta").iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["ydelta"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        r = y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(float(r["YoY_Pct"]), 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    if df["Units_TW"].notna().any():
        r = df.loc[df["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", r["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")
    if df["Orders_TW"].notna().any():
        r = df.loc[df["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", r["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


main()
```
